description: Who runs your district, from the President down to your town, and who is above whom

1.label: The whole country
1.hint: The President and the Prime Minister lead India.

2.label: Your state
2.hint: The Governor, the Chief Minister and state ministers run the state.

3.label: District officers
3.hint: IAS and IPS officers who run the district every day. Nobody votes for them.

4.label: People you vote for
4.hint: Your MP speaks for you in Parliament; your MLAs speak for you in the State Assembly.

5.label: City and departments
5.hint: The Mayor, the city commissioner and the heads of local departments.

6.label: Courts
6.hint: Judges of the High Court and the district courts. Courts are independent of the government, so they are listed apart from the levels above.

roles.president-of-india: Constitutional head of state. Appoints the PM, Governors, and judges. Commander-in-chief of armed forces.
roles.prime-minister: Head of government. Leads the Union Cabinet, sets national policy and represents India globally.
roles.governor: Constitutional head of the state. Appoints CM, can dissolve state assembly, gives assent to state bills.
roles.lieutenant-governor: Centre-appointed administrator of a Union Territory. Acts as the constitutional head and approves UT laws.
roles.chief-minister: Head of state government. Leads the state cabinet, controls state budgets and policy implementation.
roles.deputy-chief-minister: Second-in-command of the state cabinet. Often holds key portfolios alongside the CM.
roles.member-of-parliament-lok-sabha: Elected representative in the lower house. Votes on national laws, budgets and holds the government accountable.
roles.member-of-parliament: Elected representative in Parliament. Votes on national laws, budgets and holds the government accountable.
roles.member-of-legislative-assembly: Elected state representative. Votes on state laws, raises district issues in the assembly and oversees local governance.
roles.mla: Elected state representative. Votes on state laws, raises district issues in the assembly and oversees local governance.
roles.union-minister: Member of the central cabinet. Heads a ministry and makes national policy in their portfolio.
roles.union-minister-of-state: Junior central minister. Assists a Cabinet Minister in running a national ministry.
roles.cabinet-minister: State or Union cabinet member. Heads a department/ministry and makes policy within that portfolio.
roles.district-collector: Senior-most bureaucrat in the district. Handles land revenue, law and order, disaster relief and coordinates all government departments.
roles.deputy-commissioner: Senior-most IAS officer managing district administration. Equivalent to District Collector in many states.
roles.district-magistrate: Senior IAS officer with magisterial powers. Handles land revenue, public order and coordinates district departments.
roles.superintendent-of-police: Head of district police. Responsible for law enforcement, crime prevention and maintaining public order.
roles.commissioner-of-police: Head of city police in commissionerate cities. Same responsibilities as SP but for metropolitan areas.
roles.deputy-commissioner-of-police: Senior IPS officer in charge of a city police zone. Reports to the Commissioner of Police.
roles.ceo-zilla-panchayat: Chief executive of the district's rural local government. Manages MGNREGA, rural roads, water supply and village development.
roles.municipal-commissioner: Head of city municipal corporation. Manages civic infrastructure, water, sanitation, roads and urban planning.
roles.mayor: Elected head of the municipal corporation. Chairs council meetings and represents the city.
roles.chief-justice: Senior-most judge of the High Court. Heads the state's judiciary and assigns benches.
roles.chief-secretary: Senior-most IAS officer in the state. Heads the state civil service and coordinates all departments.
roles.managing-director: Head of a state public-sector undertaking or development authority. Runs day-to-day operations.
roles.chairman: Top governing officer of a board, authority or commission. Sets strategic direction.
roles.tahsildar: Sub-district revenue officer. Handles land records, mutations and revenue collection at the taluk level.
